title: Velista: a basket row records buys, and a detailed view of its lists
lede: Velista plans 0201 (the row sheet records what was bought for each list) and 0200 (a detailed view, rows/:rowKey/lists, holds each list's ask and the change of product), with backend 0273 behind the first. They ship together, so every frame draws the end state of both. Each board shows Day in English on the left and Night in Spanish on the right. The row sheet gains a heading and one text button where "Change for all lists" was; the detailed view is a sheet like the shop picker, with the chevron beside its title. No container, no tint, no banner. The design is layout A with colours A, on the stepper's number only. The detailed view opens on the row's product with "Change for all lists" under it; each list shows its own product on one line, in amber when it differs; the word Change at the end of that line is the only control that changes a list's product. A list the reader may not change keeps a stepper disabled as a whole (its border, its number and both ends) that explains itself when pressed. Under its title the detailed view says what it is for, in the sheets' secondary text, on every visit. A guest sees no "Lists and amounts". The board marked Today is drawn from the source on dev. Generated from the committed *.dc.html artboards and the notes in canvas.json. Approved by the owner on 2026-11-22. Round 5: every list of a row has the same product, so the product line of each list is gone and Change moved. Not yet approved.

annotations.text:
TODAY.
Each list has the swap icon in a bordered square, which changes the product of that list's line, and a stepper that changes what the list asks for.
Drawn from row-entries and the stepper on dev, not photographed: the staging account no longer signs in.

0201 TARGET STATES 2, 5, 6, 8; 0200 TARGET STATE 2. COLOURS A.
The heading says What you bought. Each stepper counts what this basket bought for that list in this trip; each name carries the list's ask. Básicos asks 2, has 2: its number is green. Cocina asks 1, has 2: amber. Only the number takes the colour.
The buy steppers snap to the list's ask as well as to 1000: a step lands exactly on the ask even when the step size would skip it (velista 0195 and 0201).
Lists and amounts, at the right of the heading, opens the detailed view.

0200 SPECS 1; 0201 SPECS 6.
A guest whose lists allow no change of ask or product sees no Lists and amounts and no Bought for another list.

THE DESCRIPTION.
Under the title, two lines of the sheets' secondary text say what the view is for, on every visit:
Here you change the amount and the product of each list. What you bought goes on the previous screen. / Aquí cambias la cantidad y el producto de cada lista. Lo que has comprado se apunta en la pantalla anterior.
The description names amount and product, so the heading, What each list asks for, does not repeat it.

0200 TARGET STATE 4. CHANGE, ROUND 5.
A basket row is always one product: a list that takes another product moves to that product's row. So every list here has the row's product, and no list draws a product line (picture, name, brand and size, amber). Everything else each row shows stays.
Change for all lists sits under the product, in the block it changes, when two lists or more may change.
Change product / Cambiar producto (44 px tall) is the only control that opens one list's change sheet, and shows only on a list that may change its product. These boards draw placement A, pending the owner's pick.
Fits 844 px with the description, three lists and the home indicator; nothing scrolls.

THE BUILD CHANGES THE STEPPER.
Disabled as a whole: no raised fill, the hairline (border-subtle) for the strong border, the number in text-muted at its usual size and weight, both glyphs in text-muted at 60%. In Night the faint outline stays as drawn.
Number on the sheet: Day 5.33 to 1, Night 6.66 to 1 (enabled: 18.4 and 16.3).
quantity-stepper.scss today fades only the ends (0.35 on aria-disabled); its border and number keep the enabled colours. The build adds a whole-stepper disabled state.
A press opens the note popover (anchored-popover, 280 px). For a list of the reader's own group it now says: Only people who manage this list can change what it asks for. / Solo quienes gestionan esta lista pueden cambiar lo que pide. For a list in a group the reader is not in, the words are unchanged (drawn here).
In these two sheets a stepper draws a plain minus at 1, never the trash.

0201 TARGET STATE 5.
The name gives way first: Compra semanal de la… · 1,5 kg. The ask is never cut. The line under it is cut on its own.
A product by weight shows the ask in its exact form with the unit, and the stepper the figure over kg, as the sheet stepper already does.

0200 FRAME 4, ROUND 5.
The list name and its zone · line are cut; Bought 0,5 of 1,5 kg, the stepper and Change product are not. A product name that long wraps to two lines in the block.
A product with no photo draws the app's product icon on the sunken fill, and is not a button. Both lists here may change their ask, so no disabled stepper shows.

0201 TARGET STATE 7.
Add it to another list becomes Bought for another list. Its steppers start at 0 and a press up records a buy for that list. Despensa is stepped to 1.
When the answer comes back, Despensa becomes a list of the row, Despensa · 0, with its 1 in amber, and leaves this section.

ROUND 5: WHERE CHANGE PRODUCT GOES. THE OWNER PICKS A, B OR C.
The same two rows in each: Compra semanal may change its product, Básicos may not.
A. Its own line under Bought 2 of 3, left aligned in the reading column, like Change for all lists under the product. It reads in order: list, where, bought, then the action. Only a row that may change grows.
B. At the end of the zone · line line. No row grows, but the action takes most of that line, so a long zone is cut sooner, and its 44 px target reaches over the lines around it.
C. Under the stepper, in the column of controls. Close to the thumb, but it reads as part of the amount, and the row grows as in A.
RECOMMENDED: A. The action comes where the reader finishes the list, matches where Change for all lists already sits, and never crowds the stepper or cuts the zone.

AFTER A CHANGE OF ONE LIST'S PRODUCT.
The change closes this view too: the person is back on the shopping list, where the old product's row and the new product's row are both visible. The list now sits on the new row. Nothing returns to Lists and amounts.

UNIT PRICE LINE: THE OWNER HAS NOT DECIDED.
The line under the price in the product block (0,92 € / L) stays as drawn until he does.
